about: Names the World of Warcraft: Forever client showed players in this language, read by `forge data names` (rust/crates/forge-data/src/names_sources.rs, load_observed_names) right after the client's own tables and before the web quest database, DingDB and pfQuest: the server's own name is the true one.

token: quest:, npc:, object: or item: and the id. name: as the client showed it. source: client-wdb (the client's cache of what the server sent it) or client-learning (a name the client gave a unit in play, as Polestar's Names.Learn keeps it). build: the client build, or null where it was not recorded. sha256: the hash of the file the name was read from, kept as provenance. ref: the issue or pull request the names came from.
Only the game's names, never translations from websites or other addons. Items need no record here: the client's ItemSparse table names them.
Each token once; the file is checked by forge-data's names tests.
